title: Three Texas immigration cases, eleven days
subtitle: Dates reported by KXAN, CBS Austin, KUT and The Texas Tribune
alt: Timeline of three Texas immigration cases between Aug. 16 and Aug. 27, 2026: ICE detains Victor Martinez Nieto and his 5-year-old son at an Austin traffic stop on Aug. 16; a federal judge in San Antonio orders an Austin mother released from detention within two days on Aug. 24; ICE releases her and the father and son are deported to Mexico on Aug. 25; a federal judge in Brownsville declines to hold ICE officer Christian Castro past the legal limit on Aug. 26; and Texas' 90-day cap on holding Castro before extradition expires on Aug. 27
source: KXAN, CBS Austin, KUT and The Texas Tribune

events.label: ICE detains a father and 5-year-old in Austin
events.note: Father and 5-year-old son taken to the Dilley family facility

events.label: A judge orders an Austin mother released
events.note: Judge Orlando Garcia: holding her without a hearing was unconstitutional

events.label: The mother is freed; father and son deported
events.note: She reunites with her baby; the father and son are flown out that night

events.label: A judge declines to hold Officer Castro
events.note: Judge Fernando Rodriguez Jr. found Minnesota's suit not yet ripe

events.label: Castro's 90-day detention limit expires
events.note: Gov. Greg Abbott has not signed the warrant; his review is pending
